description: Defines the sealed class hierarchy for representing various installation states in the FDroid client, including progress, confirmation, success, failure, and other statuses.

classes.name: InstallState
classes.description: Sealed class representing different states of an app installation process, such as waiting, starting, downloading, installing, and error states.

classes.name: InstallStateWithInfo
classes.description: Sealed subclass of InstallState that includes common informational properties like name, version, last updated, and icon model.

classes.name: InstallConfirmationState
classes.description: Sealed subclass of InstallStateWithInfo for states requiring user confirmation, including session ID, creation time, and intent.

methods.name: progress
methods.description: Calculates the download progress as a float between 0 and 1 based on downloaded and total bytes.

methods.name: InstallStateWithInfo
methods.description: Abstract class defining common properties for install states with additional info.

methods.name: InstallConfirmationState
methods.description: Abstract class for install states that require user confirmation, with session ID, creation time, and intent.
